info.name: Telnyx Verify and Number Lookup API

params.name: phone_number
params.description: The phone number in E.164 format, e.g. +15551234567.

params.name: type
params.description: Specifies the type of number lookup to perform. May be repeated to request both carrier and caller-name data.

items.docs: Returns number-intelligence data for the provided E.164 phone number. Without a `type` value the base object is returned; request `carrier` and/or `caller-name` to populate those sections (carrier, line type, CNAM caller name, portability city/state).
